title: SmimeError::CertChain/Other wrap String, losing source error chain
description: SmimeError::CertChain(String) and SmimeError::Other(String) stringify underlying errors (e.g. der::Error) losing the source chain. std::error::Error::source() returns None for these variants, so error-chain tools cannot traverse the cause. Idiomatic Rust: give CertChain a structured variant or at least store the source error alongside the message. Callers who want to match on 'why did cert validation fail' cannot do so without string parsing.
notes: String-wrapping errors (CertChain, Other) is a known v0.1.0 limitation. Structured error variants would require a breaking change to the enum. Approach: keep String-wrapping for now, add #[non_exhaustive] (done in MIME-68n.5), document as known limitation. Will revisit at 1.0 API freeze — at that point CertChain can gain sub-variants like CertChain::Expired, CertChain::ChainTooLong, etc.
close_reason: Deferred to post-1.0: restructuring error variants is a breaking change. #[non_exhaustive] added (MIME-68n.5) makes future structured variants possible. Notes filed for 1.0 planning.
